title.source: 模拟脑电信号如何生成？

kicker.source: 计算模型 · 从脑源到电极
kicker.en: Simulation Model · From Sources to Electrodes

intro.source: 本 App 先规定脑源活动 j，再用头部前向模型 H 计算电极能够记录的信号。H 描述脑源到电极的传递关系，j 描述脑源的活动强度。比较两套布局时使用相同的脑源设定；改变电极位置会改变对应的 H。
intro.en: The app specifies source activity j, then uses the head's forward model H to calculate electrode signals. H describes the mapping from sources to electrodes; j describes source strength. Both layouts use the same source specification, while electrode positions determine their respective H matrices.

observationFormula.source: 电极观测等于前向矩阵乘以脑源活动，再加测量噪声
observationFormula.en: Electrode observations equal the forward matrix times source activity, plus measurement noise

sourceDefinition.source: 每个脑源沿固定皮层法向的强度，可正可负。位置与方向已编码在 H 中；j 的分量是电流偶极矩，单位 A·m。
sourceDefinition.en: Each source has a signed strength along its fixed cortical normal. Positions and orientations are encoded in H; the components of j are current dipole moments in A·m.

forwardDefinition.source: 每列对应一个规定位置与方向的源，每行对应一个电极。元素表示单位偶极矩产生的电位，单位 V/(A·m)。
forwardDefinition.en: Each column represents a source at a specified position and orientation; each row represents an electrode. Entries give voltage per unit dipole moment, in V/(A·m).

noiseDefinition.source: 加入电极观测的随机噪声。当前主要指标采用由标准64导标定的独立高斯电极噪声。
noiseDefinition.en: Random noise added to electrode observations. The main metrics use independent Gaussian electrode noise calibrated against the standard 64-electrode layout.

signalDefinition.source: 所有脑源贡献在电极处叠加后，再加噪声得到的电位，单位 V；界面波形通常以 μV 显示。
signalDefinition.en: The voltage obtained by summing source contributions at each electrode and adding noise, in V. Waveforms are usually displayed in μV.

dimensions.source: 一般形式为 N 个电极、Q 个源：H 为 N×Q，j(t) 为 Q×1，y(t) 为 N×1。自动布局主实验固定64个电极；电极编辑可改变启用点数，重建目标仍为标准64导。
dimensions.en: For N electrodes and Q sources, H is N×Q, j(t) is Q×1, and y(t) is N×1. Automatic layout experiments use 64 electrodes; electrode editing can change the active count while retaining the standard 64-electrode reconstruction target.

headStep.source: 头部结构：读取 SimNIBS Ernie 的解剖体积网格，使用四面体表示头部组织。
headStep.en: Head structure: load the SimNIBS Ernie anatomical volume mesh, which represents head tissues using tetrahedra.

conductivityStep.source: 组织导电性：按组织标签指定各向同性电导率。它们是模型参数，不是从当前观测反推的数值。
conductivityStep.en: Tissue conductivity: assign isotropic conductivities by tissue label. These are model parameters, not values inferred from the current observations.

geometryStep.source: 脑源与电极：在皮层中面确定源位置和固定法向，在头表面确定点电极坐标。
geometryStep.en: Sources and electrodes: define source positions and fixed normals on the central cortical surface, and point-electrode positions on the head surface.

femStep.source: 前向求解：使用 SimNIBS 有限元和互易法，计算每个源到每个电极的单位偶极矩响应，形成 H。
femStep.en: Forward solution: use SimNIBS finite elements and reciprocity to calculate the unit-dipole response from each source to each electrode, forming H.

layoutRows.source: 已有候选点复用前向库的对应行；删减电极时选取剩余行。移动到另一个候选点就换用该点的行。坐标导入中的新位置经表面投影后直接求解 FEM，不用旧布局的评分插值。
layoutRows.en: Existing candidate positions reuse the corresponding bank rows. Removing electrodes selects the remaining rows; moving to another candidate selects that position's row. New imported positions are projected onto the surface and evaluated directly with FEM, rather than interpolating scores from an old layout.

attenuation.source: 组织导电性、脑源方向和位置造成的电位幅度差异，已经包含在 H 中。当前 H 是固定的准静态矩阵，不另外乘距离衰减系数，也不包含传播延迟或频率相关的组织滤波。
attenuation.en: Voltage differences caused by tissue conductivity, source orientation, and position are already included in H. The current H is a fixed quasi-static matrix: no extra distance-decay factor, propagation delay, or frequency-dependent tissue filter is applied.

femDetails.source: 数学与实现细节：FEM及互易法
femDetails.en: Mathematical and Implementation Details: FEM and Reciprocity

pdeExplanation.source: σ 是组织电导率，φ 是电位，Jₚ 是连续空间中的初级电流密度。Jₚ 与离散偶极矩系数 j 是不同的物理量。有限元将电位方程离散为线性系统，并用 MUMPS 求解。
pdeExplanation.en: σ is tissue conductivity, φ is potential, and Jₚ is primary current density in continuous space. Jₚ and the discrete dipole-moment coefficients j are different physical quantities. FEM discretizes the potential equation into a linear system solved with MUMPS.

reciprocitySteps.source: 计算时在电极位置和固定数值参考点之间施加归一化电流 I，求解电场 Eᵢ，再提取源位置 r_q 处沿法向 n_q 的分量。数值注流用于互易计算，不是实际刺激。
reciprocitySteps.en: The computation applies a normalization current I between an electrode and a fixed numerical reference, solves the field Eᵢ, and evaluates its component along normal n_q at source position r_q. This current is a reciprocity calculation, not physical stimulation.

reciprocityLabel.source: 当前符号约定下的互易关系与单位
reciprocityLabel.en: Reciprocity relation and units under the current sign convention

referenceRecovery.source: 电极以所在头表面三角形的重心权重采样电位；源处电场通过灰质单元的恢复与插值得到，再投影到法向。原始 H 使用固定数值参考，显示和指标计算在调用时另外处理参考。代码中的1000用于将 V/mm 换成 V/m。
referenceRecovery.en: Electrode potentials are sampled using barycentric weights on head-surface triangles. Fields at sources are recovered and interpolated from gray-matter elements, then projected onto the normals. Raw H uses a fixed numerical reference; display and metric code apply their own referencing. The factor 1000 converts V/mm to V/m.

implementationLabel.source: 实现位置（项目相对路径）

officialReference.source: 理论与流程参考：SimNIBS EEG前向计算文档
officialReference.en: Theory and Workflow: SimNIBS EEG Forward Modeling Documentation

sourceUseTable.source: 四类计算的脑源设定对照

fieldUse.source: 用脑源协方差解析计算期望重建误差，不生成具体时间波形。
fieldUse.en: Compute expected reconstruction error analytically from the source covariance, without generating a time series.

sensitivityUse.source: 逐列比较 H 中单位源活动产生的最大电位差；相同源强度在幅度比中抵消。
sensitivityUse.en: Compare the maximum voltage difference for each unit-source column of H; the common source amplitude cancels in the ratio.

localizationUse.source: 逐个激活离字典测试源，加入多次噪声，在固定字典中搜索来源，再计算位置误差。
localizationUse.en: Activate off-dictionary test sources one at a time, add repeated noise realizations, search the fixed dictionary, and calculate position errors.

waveformUse.source: 为选定的1–6个源生成时间波形，用两套 H 分别计算观测及重建。
waveformUse.en: Generate time series for 1–6 selected sources, then compute observations and reconstructions using the two H matrices.

distinction.source: 布局页的主要指标不是由“信号仿真”正在播放的那段波形算出来的。前者采用固定源先验；后者评价指定源、波形和干扰条件下的表现。
distinction.en: The main layout metrics are not calculated from the waveform currently playing in Signal Simulation. Layout evaluation uses a fixed source prior; signal simulation evaluates specified sources, waveforms, and artifact conditions.

priorDetails.source: 统计模型细节：源采样与协方差
priorDetails.en: Statistical Model Details: Source Sampling and Covariance

sourceSampling.source: 字典源在左右半球的保留皮层域内，用确定性的最远点采样选择原生中面顶点，沿原始法向。生成源按皮层三角形面积抽样，在三角形内部取点，并将插值法向归一化。离字典表示位置不同，不表示使用独立头模。
sourceSampling.en: Dictionary sources are native central-surface vertices chosen by deterministic farthest-point sampling within the retained cortical domain of each hemisphere, with their original normals. Generation sources are sampled by cortical triangle area, placed inside triangles, and assigned normalized interpolated normals. Off-dictionary means different source positions, not an independent head model.

covarianceLabel.source: 脑源先验及观测协方差

priorExplanation.source: w_q 是分配给每个源的皮层面积比例，合计为1；a 是偶极矩强度尺度。对角协方差表示源系数在此先验中不相关，方差为 a²w_q。面积权重保存在源先验中，不乘入原始 H。观测协方差按所用参考变换一致计算。
priorExplanation.en: w_q is the cortical area proportion assigned to a source, summing to one; a is the dipole-moment scale. The diagonal covariance makes source coefficients uncorrelated under this prior, with variance a²w_q. Area weights belong to the source prior and are not multiplied into raw H. Observation covariances use consistent reference transforms.

priorScope.source: 该先验按保留皮层面积分配方差，不额外偏向某个任务脑区。当前 j 的先验与波形是仿真设定，不是由真实 MI 或 P300 数据估计得到。
priorScope.en: This prior allocates variance by retained cortical area without additional task-region weighting. The current prior and waveforms for j are simulation specifications, not estimates from real MI or P300 recordings.

waveformDetails.source: 波形生成细节：节律、突发与强度
waveformDetails.en: Waveform Details: Rhythm, Bursts, and Strength

selectionExplanation.source: 单源模式选择一个冻结生成源。区域内6源模式只在所选DK图谱研究区内选择六个生成源；跨区域模式在选中的1–6个研究区各启用一个固定代表源。原始三角面的图谱标签决定源的区域归属，坐标锚点仅用于区内排序。所有模式沿用原前向模型的固定皮层法向。
selectionExplanation.en: Single-source mode selects one frozen generator. Local mode selects six generators strictly within the chosen DK-defined ROI; cross-region mode activates one fixed representative in each of 1–6 selected ROIs. Atlas labels on the original parent triangle determine membership; coordinate anchors only rank eligible sources within each ROI. All modes retain the original cortical-normal orientations.

waveformLabel.source: 基础波形、突发包络与偶极矩归一化
waveformLabel.en: Base Waveform, Burst Envelope, and Dipole-moment Normalization

waveformComponents.source: b₀ 和 b_q 分别为共享及各源独立的6–18 Hz带限随机成分，进入混合前各自去均值并归一化为单位 RMS。f_q 在9–11 Hz之间，φ_q 为随机相位；共享成分使多源波形相关。随机种子固定时生成过程可复现。
waveformComponents.en: b₀ and b_q are shared and source-specific 6–18 Hz band-limited random components, each demeaned and normalized to unit RMS before mixing. f_q lies between 9 and 11 Hz, and φ_q is a random phase. The shared component makes the source waveforms correlated. A fixed random seed makes generation reproducible.

envelopeExplanation.source: 节律模式 g(t)=1。突发模式先乘以下包络，再逐源去均值和单位 RMS 归一化；0.65 s 是高斯包络的标准差，不是整段突发长度。两种模式保持相同的归一化强度尺度。
envelopeExplanation.en: Rhythm mode uses g(t)=1. Burst mode first multiplies by the envelope below, then demeans and normalizes each source to unit RMS. The 0.65 s parameter is the Gaussian envelope's standard deviation, not the full burst duration. Both modes retain the same normalized strength scale.

amplitudeExplanation.source: 区域内6源采用所选源的归一化面积权重；跨区域K源采用等功率权重w̃_q＝1/K。单源 RMS 为10 nA·m；多源满足各源均方偶极矩之和的平方根为10 nA·m，并非每个源都是10 nA·m。重建器仍由全脑字典的对角协方差先验确定，不用当前测试波形重新拟合。
amplitudeExplanation.en: Local six-source mode uses normalized area weights among selected sources; cross-region mode uses equal power weights w̃_q = 1/K. Single-source RMS is 10 nA·m. For multiple sources, the square root of the sum of mean squared dipole moments is 10 nA·m, not 10 nA·m per source. The decoder retains the whole-brain dictionary's diagonal covariance prior and is not refitted to the current test waveforms.

comparisonFormula.source: 相同脑源输入两套布局，目标为标准64导干净场
comparisonFormula.en: The same sources drive both layouts; the target is the clean standard-64 field

comparisonConditions.source: B 表示标准64导，X 表示待评布局。两者共用头模、组织参数和源设定，电极坐标决定各自 H。噪声由标准64导的源先验标定，两套布局使用相同物理标准差；实际信噪比随接收脑信号强度而变。
comparisonConditions.en: B is the standard 64-electrode layout and X the evaluated layout. They share anatomy, tissue parameters, and source specifications; electrode coordinates determine their respective H. Noise is calibrated from the standard layout's source prior, and both layouts use the same physical standard deviation. Actual SNR varies with received brain-signal strength.

referenceExplanation.source: 波形显示采用各布局自身的平均参考。重建和定位通过 Helmert 对比处理共同参考：N个电极对应N−1个独立电位差维度，标准64导的重建目标为63维。相同噪声强度不等于相同噪声样本；配对方式以各实验协议为准。
referenceExplanation.en: Waveform displays use each layout's own average reference. Reconstruction and localization remove the common reference using Helmert contrasts: N electrodes provide N−1 independent potential-difference dimensions, and the standard-64 reconstruction target has 63 dimensions. Equal noise strength does not mean identical noise samples; pairing follows the experiment protocol.

targetExplanation.source: 两套重建器估计同一个无噪声标准64导目标场 z_B。采集位置不同并不改变比较目标；重建误差、幅度比及定位评分的定义在下一章分别说明。
targetExplanation.en: Both decoders estimate the same clean standard-64 target field z_B. Different measurement positions do not change that target. Reconstruction error, amplitude ratios, and localization scores are defined separately in the next chapter.

metricsLink.source: 继续阅读：三项指标如何计算？
metricsLink.en: Continue: How the Three Metrics Are Calculated

artifactsFormula.source: 脑电前向信号加上心电、眼电干扰和测量噪声
artifactsFormula.en: Forward-modeled brain signals plus ECG, EOG artifacts, and measurement noise

artifactExplanation.source: ECG 使用合成心搏模板，EOG 使用合成眨眼波形；分别通过固定的坐标相关空间函数加入两套布局。它们用于设定干扰条件，不是心脏、躯干或眼球 FEM 的输出。基础布局指标只包含规定的测量噪声，ECG/EOG条件在信号仿真中另外评价。
artifactExplanation.en: ECG uses a synthetic heartbeat template and EOG a synthetic blink waveform. Fixed coordinate-dependent spatial functions project them onto both layouts. They define artifact conditions rather than outputs from cardiac, torso, or ocular FEM. Base layout metrics include the specified measurement noise; ECG/EOG conditions are evaluated separately in Signal Simulation.

artifactCalibration.source: 干扰空间场先由标准64导标定，再将相同系数用于当前布局；强度滑块改变附加干扰，不改变脑电 H 或重建器。比较不同干扰强度时复用同一脑信号和噪声样本。
artifactCalibration.en: Artifact fields are calibrated against the standard layout, then the same coefficients are applied to the evaluated layout. The strength control changes added artifacts, not the brain H matrix or decoder. Comparisons across artifact strengths reuse the same brain signals and noise samples.

interactionLink.source: 查看信号仿真的操作与显示说明
interactionLink.en: Read Signal Simulation Controls and Display Details

parametersScope.source: 以下概括当前默认的 Ernie 4096/256 源协议，不读取当前选中记录，也不覆盖历史实验或独立源复评的参数。具体结果以记录中的协议、源数量和噪声设定为准。
parametersScope.en: These values summarize the current default Ernie 4096/256-source protocol. They do not read the selected record or override historical experiments or independent-source reevaluations. Interpret each result using its recorded protocol, source counts, and noise settings.

headValue.source: 单个 Ernie 解剖 FEM；标准64采用 Ernie 空间中按 BioSemi64 通道名匹配的模板坐标。
headValue.en: One anatomical Ernie FEM head; the reference uses template coordinates in Ernie space matched to BioSemi64 channel names.

sourcesValue.source: 4096个字典源（每半球2048）；256个离字典生成源（每半球128）。均为保留皮层域的固定法向源。
sourcesValue.en: 4096 dictionary sources (2048 per hemisphere) and 256 off-dictionary generation sources (128 per hemisphere), with fixed normals in the retained cortical domain.

bankValue.source: 候选库5387×4352；参考库64×4352。4352列由字典源与生成源组成，不表示全部同时激活；实际可选电极还受当前表面筛选约束。
bankValue.en: Candidate bank: 5387×4352; reference bank: 64×4352. The 4352 columns combine dictionary and generation sources, not simultaneous activations. Current surface-admissibility rules further restrict selectable electrodes.

evaluationValue.source: 源强度尺度10 nA·m；标准64导源先验标定的名义SNR为20 dB；定位逐个测试256源，每源16次噪声。
evaluationValue.en: Source scale: 10 nA·m. Nominal SNR: 20 dB, calibrated from the standard layout's source prior. Localization tests 256 sources one at a time, with 16 noise realizations per source.

samplingValue.source: 正式波形200 Hz、20秒（4000点）；抗混叠预览50 Hz、前8秒。正式评分使用完整波形，不使用显示预览。
samplingValue.en: Evaluation waveforms: 200 Hz for 20 s (4000 samples). Anti-aliased display preview: 50 Hz for the first 8 s. Scores use the full waveform, not the display preview.

modelLink.en: Where Do H and j Come From? Read the Signal Generation Guide

interactionIntro.source: 固定一个已完成布局，选择单源、区域内6源或跨区域1–6源场景，设置波形和干扰后运行。源位置与方向、波形构造及重建先验统一见“模拟脑电信号如何生成”。
interactionIntro.en: Start from a completed layout, choose a single source, six local sources, or 1–6 cross-region sources, set waveforms and artifacts, and run. Source positions and orientations, waveform construction, and the reconstruction prior are explained in How Simulated EEG Is Generated.

termDefinition.source: “区域”指头表面的电极布置范围；“脑源位置”指模拟活动所在的皮层位置。“布局”指一组电极的具体坐标，自动布局固定64点，电极编辑可删减；“配置”是区域数、位置限制和尺寸等输入条件；“记录”是一次保存的结果或搜索状态。
termDefinition.en: A placement region is an electrode area on the head surface; a source position is a cortical location of simulated activity. A layout is a set of electrode coordinates: automatic layouts use 64 points, while electrode editing can remove points. A configuration specifies region count, placement constraints, and size. A record is a saved result or search status.

comparisonCounts.source: 固定64点布局实验比较相同电极数量下的位置分布；电极编辑单独评价删减后的N点布局。参考布局始终为标准全头64导，目标场保持不变。
comparisonCounts.en: Fixed-64 layout experiments compare spatial distributions at the same electrode count. Electrode editing separately evaluates an N-point layout after removals. The reference remains the standard whole-head 64-electrode layout, and the target field is unchanged.

comparisonHeading.source: 明确电极数量与比较目标
comparisonHeading.en: Identify Electrode Counts and the Comparison Target

comparisonSummary.source: 这里沿用上方模型的脑源、前向矩阵和噪声定义：y_X 是待评布局的含噪观测，z_64 是标准64导的无噪声目标场。两套布局按相同源设定和物理噪声尺度比较。
comparisonSummary.en: Using the source, forward-matrix, and noise definitions above, y_X is the evaluated layout's noisy observation and z_64 is the clean standard-64 target field. The layouts are compared under the same source specification and physical noise scale.
